mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE dept_tree AS ( SELECT dept_id, parent_id, ancestors, dept_name, order_num, leader, phone, email, status, del_flag FROM sys_dept WHERE parent_id = 0 AND del_flag = '0' UNION ALL SELECT d.dept_id, d.parent_id, d.ancestors, d.dept_name, d.order_num, d.leader, d.phone, d.email, d.status, d.del_flag FROM sys_dept d INNER JOIN dept_tree dt ON d.parent_id = dt.dept_id WHERE d.del_flag = '0' ) SELECT * FROM dept_tree ORDER BY ancestors, order_num
